decisions.reason: The requested English caption style name may be a specific exception to the Danish naming rule and may or may not retain the NXQ prefix; the source does not resolve how the global convention applies.
Naming the caption style does not change the requirement to implement the complete specified style catalog.
The caption style name does not alter the required theme colors.
The source concerns the name of the image and table caption style, not Heading 3 typography.
The source does not change the title font size or any other title typography rule.
The requested caption style name has no effect on bullet appearance, alignment, scaling, or color.
Mention of table labels is unrelated to containment of pasted tables and columns within page margins.
The caption style name does not change Tab-driven list hierarchy behavior.
The source does not change the expected stability of content pasted from legacy templates.
The caption style naming decision does not alter post-paste manual line-break behavior.
The source does not change the supported Word environment or general reliability expectations.
The caption style name does not affect alignment of numbered lists at 10 or higher.
